snippet.title: Sticker Picker | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #StickerPicker

🇧🇷🇵🇹
❌🔍 Encontre as diferenças e descubra surpresas especiais!
Em Sticker Picker, sua atenção aos detalhes será colocada à prova em cenários vibrantes e cuidadosamente ilustrados. Procure diferenças escondidas, enfrente desafios cada vez mais inteligentes e reencontre alguns dos personagens mais queridos da Afil Games em artes exclusivas.

🎮 Disponível a partir de 31 de agosto no Xbox, com 20% de desconto no lançamento!

🇺🇸🇬🇧
❌🔍 Spot the differences and discover special surprises!
In Sticker Picker, your attention to detail will be put to the test across vibrant and beautifully illustrated scenes. Hunt for hidden differences, face increasingly tricky challenges, and revisit some of Afil Games' most beloved characters in exclusive artwork.

🎮 Available from August 31 on Xbox, with a 20% launch discount!

KEY FEATURES
❌ Hunt for hidden differences across vibrant, beautifully illustrated scenes;
❌ Test your observation skills with increasingly tricky challenges;
❌ Explore charming Afil Games characters in exclusive artwork and surprises;

Grab Yours 
🎮 Xbox One: https://x.gd/LjBVy
🎮 Xbox Series: https://x.gd/eyxRH
🎮 Windows: https://x.gd/b2bZj
